faq.hintWithCount: {count, plural, =0 {Babu FAQ tukuna} =1 {An ƙara FAQ 1} other {An ƙara FAQ #}}

widget.title: Tsara widget
widget.description: Daidaita launcher da panel na hira da alamarka — launuka, matsayi, avatar, da lakabin launcher da masu siya ke gani.
widget.hint: Ba dole ba ne, amma widget mai alama yana fi juyowa.

enableWidget.title: Kunna widget na shago
enableWidget.description: Kunna babban maɓalli domin wakilin ya bayyana a shagonka. Yana buƙatar maɓallin OpenAI na sama.

testChat.title: Gwada kafin ƙaddamarwa
testChat.description: Yi amfani da tab ɗin gwajin hira don hira kamar mai siya, sannan ka duba ainihin tattaunawa bayan ya fara aiki.
testChat.hintWithCount: {count, plural, =0 {Babu tattaunawa tukuna} =1 {Tattaunawa 1 zuwa yanzu} other {Tattaunawa # zuwa yanzu}}

flow.title: Yadda tattaunawa ke gudana
flow.description: Abin da ke faruwa a bayan fage duk lokacin da mai siya ya aika saƙo.

open.title: Mai siya ya buɗe widget
open.body: Launcher yana bayyana a shagonka kuma yana gaishe shi da saƙon gaisuwa da ka saita.

ask.title: Yana tambaya da kalmominsa
ask.body: “Kuna da jaket mai hana ruwa kasa da dala 100?”, “Ina odana?”, ko “Menene dokar mayarwa taku?” — babu buƙatar menu ko keyword.

tools.title: Model yana zaɓar kayan aiki
tools.body: Dangane da ƙwarewar da aka kunna, wakilin zai iya bincika kundin kayanka, ɗauko bayanan kayayyaki, karanta FAQ, duba kwando, bincika matsayin oda, ko ƙara kaya zuwa kwando.

data.title: Yana ɗauko bayanan kai tsaye daga shagonka
data.body: Sakamako suna fitowa daga ainihin kayanka da manufofin da ka shigar — don haka amsoshi suna kasancewa masu tushe, ba ƙirƙira ba. Ana nuna kaya a matsayin cards masu kyau, ba rubutu kawai ba.

reply.title: Yana amsa kuma zai iya ɗaukar mataki
reply.body: Mai siya yana samun takaitacciyar amsa tare da cards na kaya, maɓallan ƙara-kwando, ko mika shi zuwa checkout idan ya shirya saya.

logged.title: Ana rubuta komai
logged.body: Ana adana kowace tattaunawa, saƙo da aiki domin ka iya dubawa a tab ɗin Conversations kuma ka bibiyi aiki a Overview.

faq.title: Ka kiyaye FAQ daidai
faq.body: Wakilin yana amsa tambayoyin manufofi daga FAQ da farko. Rufe shipping, returns, sizing da warranty domin kada ya yi zato.

instructions.title: Rubuta umarni a takaice
instructions.body: Yi amfani da tab ɗin Behavior don saita muryar alama da abin da ya kamata ko bai kamata a yi ba. Ka taƙaita — ana ƙara shi a kowane turn.

model.title: Fara da model mai daidaito
model.body: Ƙananan temperature na sa amsoshi su fi mayar da hankali. Ƙara girman model ne kawai idan kana buƙatar zurfin tunani, domin yana ƙara kuɗi a kowace amsa.

recs.title: Daidaita yawan shawarwari
recs.body: Nuna kayayyaki 3–4 a kowace amsa. Da yawa suna rikita masu siya; kaɗan kuma suna rage zaɓi.

key.title: Kare maɓallin API ɗinka
key.body: Maɓallin OpenAI yana nan ne a yanayin uwar garke kaɗai. Kada ka manna shi a storefront ko ka raba shi a fili.

review.title: Bita kan ainihin tattaunawa
review.body: Duba tab ɗin Conversations akai-akai domin gano tambayoyin da wakilin ya rasa kuma ka ƙara su zuwa FAQ.

cta.prompt: A shirye kake ka gan shi yana aiki?

modelRuntime.title: Model da runtime
modelRuntime.enableWidgetDescription: Widget zai kasance a ɓoye har sai an saita OpenAI.
modelRuntime.modelDescription: Manyan model za su iya yin tunani mai zurfi amma suna da tsada a kowace buƙata.
modelRuntime.reasoningEffortDescription: Ana amfani da shi ga models masu reasoning; in ba haka ba ana watsi da shi.
modelRuntime.temperatureDescription: Ƙasa = mai da hankali sosai, sama = ƙarin kirkira (0–1).
modelRuntime.maxRecommendationsDescription: Mafi yawan kayayyakin da za a nuna a amsa ɗaya (1–8).

capabilityMeta.productQADescription: Amsa tambayoyi game da kaya da specifications.
capabilityMeta.recommendationsDescription: Ba da shawarwarin kaya bisa bukatar mai siya.
capabilityMeta.cartActionsDescription: Bari wakilin ya ƙara ko cire kaya daga kwando.
capabilityMeta.checkoutHandoffDescription: Kai masu siya zuwa checkout idan sun shirya.
capabilityMeta.orderStatusDescription: Nemo kuma raba bayanan bin oda.

identity.title: Suna da salo
identity.greetingDescription: Ana nuna shi a matsayin saƙon farko idan mai siya ya buɗe widget.
identity.instructionsPlaceholder: Muryar alama, tunatarwar tsarin mayarwa, salon shawarwari...
identity.instructionsDescription: Ana haɗa shi da system prompt a kowane turn. Ka takaita shi.
identity.escalationDescription: Ana aikawa idan wakilin ba zai iya taimakawa ba kuma yana buƙatar handoff.

faq.title: Ilimi da FAQ
faq.description: Wakilin yana bincika a nan idan masu siya sun tambayi shipping, returns, sizing, warranty, ko wasu manufofi. Har zuwa shigarwa 50.
faq.empty: Babu FAQ tukuna. Ƙara tambayoyi na gama gari domin wakilin ya amsa tambayoyin manufofi ba tare da ƙirƙira ba.
faq.questionPlaceholder: Tambaya (misali, shipping yana ɗaukar tsawon wane lokaci?)
faq.answerPlaceholder: Amsar da wakilin zai bayar. Ka sa ta zama ta gaskiya kuma a takaice.
faq.tagsPlaceholder: Tags na zaɓi, a raba su da koma (shipping, returns, sizing)

appearance.title: Bayyanar
appearance.headerTitleDescription: Ana nuna shi a header na hira. Idan babu komai, ana komawa ga sunan wakili.
appearance.expandedSizeDescription: Ana amfani da shi ga widget mai iyo bayan ajiyewa.
appearance.showFooterTextDescription: Nuna ƙaramin lakabi a ƙasan taga hira.
appearance.avatarUploadTitle: Ja ka sauke hoto, ko danna don zaɓa
appearance.avatarUploadDescription: Tsarin hoto: JPG, PNG, JPEG, WEBP.
appearance.avatarSizeGuide: Girman da aka ba da shawara: 256 x 256 px
appearance.headerAvatarDescription: Ana nuna shi a header na hira. Idan babu, yana komawa favicon na shagonka.
